reviews.text: We booked a section off for a llittle party here with about 20 people.  The staff was awesome.  So friendly and helpful.  The food was very good and the service was quick.  The place restaurant and bar was very well kept up and clean. They also have a outdoor patio and if weather permitting they have a roof top patio. Thanks to the staff for great service.  Highly recommend this place.

We always go here and we have never been disappointed.
Everything is quiet decent and always easy to find a table
The burger and tacos are really good
